name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat on bench, grip bar slightly wider than shoulders, lower to mid-chest, press up.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set bench to 30-45 degrees, press dumbbells from chest level to lockout.

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Adjust seat height so handles are at chest level, press forward to extension.

name: Cable Fly
instructions: Set cables at chest height, bring handles together in front of chest with slight elbow bend.

name: Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge at hips, pull bar to lower chest/upper abdomen, squeeze shoulder blades.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit upright, pull handle to lower chest, squeeze shoulder blades together.

name: Dumbbell Row
instructions: Support with one hand on bench, row dumbbell to hip, squeeze lat at top.

name: Pull-ups
instructions: Hang from bar with overhand grip, pull until chin clears bar, lower with control.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Pull bar to upper chest while squeezing lats, control the return.

name: Overhead Press
instructions: Press bar from shoulders to overhead lockout, keep core tight.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Press dumbbells from shoulders to overhead, control the descent.

name: Lateral Raise
instructions: Raise dumbbells to sides until arms parallel to floor, slight bend in elbows.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand beside cable, raise arm to side until parallel to floor.

name: Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Bend at hips, raise dumbbells to sides squeezing rear delts.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Pull rope to face level with elbows high, squeeze rear delts.

name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Bar on upper back, squat down until thighs parallel, drive up through heels.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Feet shoulder width, lower weight until knees at 90 degrees, press up.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold dumbbell at chest, squat down between legs, stand up.

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Extend legs until straight, squeeze quads, lower with control.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hinge at hips with slight knee bend, lower bar along legs, squeeze glutes to stand.

name: Conventional Deadlift
instructions: Bar over mid-foot, hinge and grip, drive through legs to lockout.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold dumbbells in front, hinge at hips keeping back flat, return to standing.

name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Curl legs toward glutes, squeeze hamstrings, lower with control.

name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Step forward into lunge, back knee nearly touches floor, drive forward to next step.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Rear foot on bench, lower until front thigh parallel, drive up.

name: Hip Thrust
instructions: Upper back on bench, drive hips up squeezing glutes, lower with control.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Rise onto toes, pause at top, lower until stretch in calves.

name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Seated with knees bent, raise heels, lower for full stretch.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Curl bar up keeping elbows stationary, squeeze biceps, lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Curl dumbbells with supinated grip, squeeze at top, lower slowly.

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Curl with neutral grip (palms facing each other), squeeze at top.

name: Cable Curl
instructions: Curl cable handle from low position, maintain constant tension.

name: Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Push cable down until arms fully extended, squeeze triceps, return with control.

name: Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Hold dumbbell overhead, lower behind head, extend to lockout.

name: Skull Crusher
instructions: Lower bar to forehead keeping elbows stationary, extend to lockout.

name: Dips
instructions: Lower until upper arms parallel to floor, press up to lockout.

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneel facing cable, crunch down bringing elbows toward knees.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from bar, raise legs until parallel to floor or higher, lower with control.

name: Plank
instructions: Hold straight body position on forearms and toes, maintain neutral spine.

name: Barbell Shrugs
instructions: Shrug shoulders straight up toward ears, pause, lower with control.

name: Hammer Strength Plate-Loaded Seated/Standing Shrug PL-SH
instructions: Use the seated or standing setup, grip handles, shrug shoulders upward, pause, and lower under control.

name: Wrist Curl
instructions: Rest forearm on bench, curl wrist up squeezing forearm, lower slowly.

name: Push-ups
instructions: Hands shoulder width, lower chest to floor, push up to lockout.

name: Inverted Row
instructions: Hang from bar at chest height, pull chest to bar, lower with control.

name: Hammer Strength Incline Press
instructions: Adjust seat so handles align with upper chest, press forward with controlled motion.

name: Hammer Strength Decline Press
instructions: Targets lower chest, press handles forward and slightly down.

name: Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Chest Press
instructions: Each arm moves independently, allows for unilateral focus.

name: Hammer Strength Low Row
instructions: Chest against pad, pull handles to lower ribs, squeeze lats.

name: Hammer Strength High Row
instructions: Pull handles toward upper chest, emphasizes upper back and rear delts.

name: Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Row
instructions: Independent arms allow unilateral work, great for fixing imbalances.

name: Hammer Strength Pulldown
instructions: Smooth arc motion, pull handles to upper chest.

name: Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Pulldown
instructions: Each arm moves independently, can do unilateral or alternating.

name: Hammer Strength Shoulder Press
instructions: Press handles overhead, arc motion reduces shoulder stress.

name: Hammer Strength V-Squat
instructions: Shoulders under pads, squat down with controlled motion.

name: Hammer Strength Leg Press
instructions: Linear plate-loaded leg press, feet shoulder width on platform.

name: Hack Squat Machine
instructions: Back against pad, squat down until thighs parallel, press up.

name: Pendulum Squat
instructions: Arc motion reduces spinal loading, excellent quad isolation.

name: Belt Squat Machine
instructions: Belt around hips, zero spinal loading, pure leg drive.

name: Smith Machine Squat
instructions: Feet slightly forward, squat in guided path.

name: Smith Machine Bench Press
instructions: Bench under bar, press in guided path. Good for training to failure safely.

name: Smith Machine Incline Press
instructions: Set bench to 30-45 degrees under Smith bar, press in guided path.

name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Seated position, curl legs under pad, better hamstring stretch than lying.

name: Standing Leg Curl
instructions: Standing single-leg curl, great for unilateral hamstring work.

name: Glute Drive Machine
instructions: Machine hip thrust, belt around hips, drive through glutes.

name: Hip Abductor Machine
instructions: Push legs outward against pads, targets gluteus medius.

name: Hip Adductor Machine
instructions: Squeeze legs inward against pads, targets inner thigh.

name: Glute Kickback Machine
instructions: Push leg back in arc motion, squeeze glute at top.

name: Pec Deck (Machine Fly)
instructions: Bring arms together in front of chest, squeeze pecs.

name: Rear Delt Machine (Reverse Pec Deck)
instructions: Face the pec deck, pull handles back squeezing rear delts.

name: Machine Lateral Raise
instructions: Elbows against pads, raise arms to sides. Constant tension throughout.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Grip handles at shoulder level, press overhead.

name: Assisted Pull-up Machine
instructions: Counterweight assists the pull-up. Set weight to reduce bodyweight.

name: Assisted Dip Machine
instructions: Counterweight assists the dip. Set weight to reduce bodyweight.

name: Machine Preacher Curl
instructions: Arms braced on pad, curl handles up squeezing biceps.

name: Machine Tricep Extension
instructions: Elbows braced, extend arms down squeezing triceps.

name: Machine Ab Crunch
instructions: Crunch forward against resistance, controlled return.

name: Torso Rotation Machine
instructions: Rotate torso against resistance, works obliques.

name: Wide Grip Cable Row
instructions: Wide lat bar attachment, pull to chest emphasizing upper back.

name: Close Grip Cable Row
instructions: V-bar or close grip handle, pull to lower chest.

name: Close Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: V-bar attachment, pull to upper chest.

name: Straight Arm Pulldown
instructions: Arms straight, pull bar down to thighs, squeeze lats.

name: Cable Chest Press
instructions: Cables at chest height, press forward. Constant tension throughout.

name: Incline Cable Fly
instructions: Incline bench between cables, fly motion from low to high.

name: High to Low Cable Fly
instructions: Cables high, bring handles down and together. Targets lower chest.

name: Low to High Cable Fly
instructions: Cables low, bring handles up and together. Targets upper chest.

name: Cable Tricep Kickback
instructions: Bent over, extend arm back against cable resistance.

name: Cable Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Face away from cable, extend arms overhead.

name: Preacher Curl
instructions: Arms on preacher bench, curl up squeezing biceps, lower slowly.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Incline bench, arms hang down, curl with full stretch.

name: Concentration Curl
instructions: Seated, elbow braced on inner thigh, curl dumbbell.

name: Plate-Loaded Row Machine
instructions: Chest against pad, pull handles back squeezing lats.

name: T-Bar Row
instructions: Straddle the bar, pull to chest, squeeze back.

name: Chest Supported Row
instructions: Chest on incline bench, row dumbbells up, eliminates momentum.

name: Meadows Row
instructions: Landmine setup, row with one arm in a sweeping motion.

name: Landmine Press
instructions: Bar anchored at one end, press other end overhead at angle.

name: Deficit Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand on plates for extra range of motion, increased hamstring stretch.

name: Single Leg Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Balance on one leg, hinge forward with dumbbell, great for stability.

name: Good Morning
instructions: Bar on back, hinge at hips keeping back flat.

name: Front Squat
instructions: Bar in front rack position, squat down keeping torso upright.

name: Sissy Squat
instructions: Lean back on heels, bend knees forward, extreme quad stretch.

name: Reverse Lunge
instructions: Step backward into lunge, more glute emphasis than forward lunge.

name: Step Up
instructions: Step onto bench driving through heel, minimize push off.

name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart, sit hips down and back, then stand while keeping the whole foot grounded.

name: Nordic Curl
instructions: Anchor the ankles, brace the trunk, lower under control, and use the hands for assistance as needed.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with feet planted, brace, drive the hips up, and pause briefly at full extension.

name: Pike Push-Up
instructions: Lift the hips into an inverted-V position, lower the head between the hands, and press back up.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Fly
instructions: Hinge with a neutral spine, let the arms hang, and move the dumbbells out and slightly back without shrugging.

name: Band Pull-Apart
instructions: Hold the band at shoulder height, pull it apart by moving from the upper back, and return with control.

name: Barbell Calf Raise
instructions: Stand tall with the bar secure, lower the heels under control, and rise through the balls of the feet.

name: Dumbbell Calf Raise
instructions: Hold the dumbbells at your sides, lower the heels under control, and rise through the balls of the feet.

name: Bodyweight Calf Raise
instructions: Use a stable stance, lower the heels slowly, and pause at the top of each calf raise.

name: Barbell Shrug
instructions: Stand tall with the bar, lift the shoulders straight up without rolling, and lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Wrist Curl
instructions: Support the forearms, curl the wrists through a controlled range, and avoid moving from the elbows.

name: Close Grip Bench Press
instructions: Use a shoulder-width grip, lower the bar to the lower chest, and press while keeping the elbows controlled.
